plan.flow: Sign in → role-specific work. Warehouse staff receive, inspect, move and pack stock; dispatchers manage orders and routes; drivers load and deliver with offline work; quality staff decide cases and recalls; customers order, track deliveries and answer recalls; administrators maintain accounts and rules; auditors inspect read-only records.

screens.title: Sign in
screens.prompt: Centre one panel no wider than 440px both ways, with Meridian's square M and name above it and no other furniture. Heading Sign in, one sentence explaining staff can use a Meridian Microsoft account or individual credentials; email, password, Sign in primary action, and a separate Continue with Meridian Microsoft account control. Customer password sign-in proceeds to a one-time code; do not offer customer social sign-in or customer SSO. Show Request password reset as a text link.

system.digest: Use 2px corners on panels, buttons, fields and photographs. Edge panels with a 1px solid rule and no shadow. Keep spacing on an 8px rhythm, with 16px within panels and 32px between larger sections. Set the main heading at 28px/650, section headings at 20px/650, and smaller headings at 16px/600. Body text is 16px/1.5, with supporting text never below 14px. Tables have 48px rows separated by a 1px rule, and figures align vertically in their columns. Primary buttons have a solid fill and contrasting text; secondary buttons have a surface fill and 1px rule; both are 48px tall. Fields are 48px tall, surface-filled, ruled and labelled above. Show status in short text paired with its semantic color, never color alone. Crop real photographs to 4:3 around the subject, repeat the same image for the same person, and let internal row dividers meet panel boundaries flush without decorative marks beside values.

motion.signature: Saved handoff: when queued work really synchronizes, the status text rises 8px while opacity goes .6→1 over 260ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
motion.ambient: Only during actual sync, the waiting-status dot breathes from opacity .7 to 1 on a 6s ease-in-out infinite cycle; it stops when sync ends.

Large, authentic product photographs without ornamental framing.

One obvious action at a time with touch-sized controls for movement.
